questions.question: What is a Kubernetes Pod?
options: The smallest deployable unit in Kubernetes that contains one or more containers.
answer: The smallest deployable unit in Kubernetes that contains one or more containers.
questions.hint: A Pod is the fundamental unit of deployment in K8s.
questions.rationale: A Pod is the smallest and most basic unit in the Kubernetes object model. It represents a single instance of an application running in a cluster and can contain one or more containers.

questions.question: Which of the following are benefits of using Kubernetes?
questions.hint: Kubernetes is known for its automation and reliability features.
questions.rationale: Kubernetes provides robust features for automated scaling, self-healing (restarting failed containers), and centralized secrets and configuration management.
